data.title: 黍 · 听雨时把热茶移到你身边
data.description: 雨天家中檐廊，黍穿青黛交领常服坐在小茶桌边，把一杯热茶轻轻移到你面前，另一只手压住被风掀起的薄毯。她微微转头笑着看你，身旁空椅已经摆好，雨水落在栏外。
data.action: 将茶杯移向镜头，另一手压住薄毯并看你
data.lighting: 雨天冷柔光与檐下暖灯
data.promptProse: Under the covered veranda, Shu moves a warm teacup toward the viewer and presses the edge of a light blanket down before the breeze can lift it. She turns with a gentle smile, the empty chair beside her already drawn close to the table. Rain falls beyond the railing while a sheltered lamp warms the ivory cross-collar fabric and sparse golden grain embroidery along her teal skirt.
